guidance: This result does not establish food safety. Follow a current tested process, product directions, and authoritative food-safety guidance.
method: Mass balance on cacao content by total weight. Label cacao percentages are treated as exact shares of each chocolate's weight. Batch mode solves chocolate A = batch weight x (target - B%) / (A% - B%) and assigns the remainder to B; adjust mode solves added B = A on hand x (target - A%) / (B% - target). The target must lie between the two percentages, and equal percentages are rejected. Grams convert at 28.349523125 g per ounce. Displayed weights round to 0.1 g or 0.01 oz. No allowance is made for rounded label values, added cocoa butter or milk fat, inclusions, evaporation, or chocolate left in the bowl.
